entities.name: Emancipation and the Emergence of Free Society
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The slave trade was abolished in 1807 and full emancipation came in 1834. The freed Black majority gradually established independent communities, while the white merchant elite (the 'Bay Street Boys') maintained economic and political control.
